name: Sika Fibermesh-150
paste:
SIKA® FIBERMESH®-150: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Fibermesh®-150, April 2024, Version 01.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sika_fibermesh_-150.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Fibermesh®-150 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2024, Version 01.05).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Fibermesh®-150, micro-reinforcement system for concrete—100 percent virgin homopolymer polypropylene multifilament (monofilament) fibers .
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Fibermesh®-150 act mechanically by supporting the aggregate within the concrete with multidimen-sional fiber network and developing a uniform bleed system. The fiber does not affect the curing process chemically and does not absorb water. The Sika® Fibermesh®-150 can be used in all types of concrete applications to control plastic shrinkage and settlement cracking. Typical applications include:
    - Slabs on ground
    - Residential applications: side-walks, driveways, decks, curbs
    - Precast elements,
    - Overlays / toppings
    - Stucco
    - Shotcrete
    - Roads / Pavements
    - Bridge Decks
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Fibermesh®-150
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: MICRO-SYNTHETIC MONOFILAMENT FIBER
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Part 2: Class Ia and carries the CE marking
    - Complies with ASTM C1116/C1116M, Type III fiber reinforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 14889-2:2006: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - ASTM C1116: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - ASTM D7508: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increase resistance to explosive spalling
    - Reduces plastic shrinkage cracking
    - Reduces plastic settlement cracking
    - Improves impact, shatter and abrasion resistance
    - Enhances durability
    - Promotes uniform bleed and reduces bleed water
    - Inhibits and controls the formation of intrinsic cracking in concrete
    - Increases cohesion and reduces segregation
    - Reduces freeze/thaw damage
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Fiber Type: Monofilament micro synthetic fibre
    - Density: 0.91 g/cm³
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: Length: 12 mm; Diameter: 0.03 mm
    - Melting point: 162 oC
    - Ignition temperature: 404 ° C
    - Resistance to alkalinity: Excellent
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Sika® Fibermesh®-150 fibers are available in 1 kg bags and 200 kg bulk bags. The 1 kg degradable bag is a standard size. The bags are packed into cartons and palletized.
    - Shelf life: When stored in dry conditions shelf life is 5 years
    - Storage conditions: Sika® Fibermesh®-150 should be stored in a dry warehouse. Protect product from the rain.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2024, Version 01.05) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2024, Version 01.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. The dosage of the Sika® Fibermesh®-150 will vary according to the type of application and performance requirements. Standard recommended dosage ratio of Sika® Fibermesh®-150 is 1.0 kg/m³ of concrete. For explosive spalling resistance the dosage rate will be between 1.0 kg/m³ and 2.0 kg/m³ ,depending on the design requirements. Dosages outside the recommended dosage range can be used to meet project specific requirements. If this is the case please contact your Sika representative for technical support.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Depending on the dosage rate and the mix design , Sika® Fibermesh®-150 might reduce the workability of concrete, especially in high-slump and super-workable concrete.
    - Adequate mix design and preliminary trials shall be accomplished to achieve the target slump/spread.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2024, Version 01.05) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Fibermesh®-150, April 2024, Version 01.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sika_fibermesh_-150.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika® Fibermesh®, version 30/07/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/Sika%C2%AE%20Fibermesh%C2%AE%20GHS%207.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Polypropylene-based micro fibres, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/epd-polypropylene-basedmicrofibres.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
